content.user_title: Edit Videos with Intent-Based RunComfy Routing
content.value_statement: Different video edits need different models and input settings. This skill selects a RunComfy route and supplies model-specific prompts for restyling, background changes, or motion transfer.
actual_capabilities: Select Wan, Kling, or Lucy according to the requested editing intent.
Prepare Wan background and packaging edits with preservation instructions and optional reference images.
Configure Kling motion transfer with reference media, character orientation, and original sound settings.
Prepare Lucy outfit or lighting changes with face and motion preservation goals.
Invoke RunComfy model endpoints with JSON inputs and a selected output directory.
Explain model limits, authentication prerequisites, and documented CLI exit codes.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, an authenticated account, network access, and source media URLs; processing is remote.
Wan accepts 2-10 second MP4 or MOV inputs up to 100 MB, with output resolution capped at 1080p.
Kling output is capped at 10 seconds for image orientation or 30 seconds for video orientation.
Lucy is limited to 720p without aspect ratio control; each call uses one model without multi-route blending.

use_cases.title: Refresh Presenter Backgrounds
use_cases.description: Change a short presenter video's background with Wan while requesting preservation of face, pose, lip movement, and source audio.

use_cases.title: Preview Packaging Designs
use_cases.description: Use a reference image to replace packaging in a product clip while requesting consistent framing and hand movement.

use_cases.title: Transfer Character Motion
use_cases.description: Apply motion from a reference video to a target character through Kling with an appropriate orientation and duration.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Outfit Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Lucy to change the outfit in [video URL] to [outfit]. Preserve face and motion. Save results in [output directory].

prompt_templates.title: Presenter Background Replacement
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wan for [video URL]. Preserve face, pose, and lip movement. Replace the background with [scene]. Keep source audio. Save to [output directory].

prompt_templates.title: Reference-Based Packaging Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wan to replace packaging in [video URL] using [reference image URL]. Preserve framing and hand movement. Save results in [output directory].

prompt_templates.title: Controlled Motion Transfer
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Kling to transfer motion from [reference video URL] to [character image URL]. Use image orientation and preserve original sound. Keep output within 10 seconds. Place the character on [frame side]. Save to [output directory].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: motion, composition, and duration constraints

output_examples.input: Replace a six-second presenter video's background with a neutral office and keep the original speech.
output: Preservation goals: retain the speaker's face, pose, and lip movement.

output_examples.input: Apply motion from a dance reference to my character image and keep the reference audio.
output: Illustrative edit plan: Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control.
Inputs: target character image and motion reference video.
Character orientation: image, with output capped at 10 seconds.
Sound setting: retain original reference audio.

output_examples.input: Change the subject's outfit to business attire without changing the face or movement.
output: Illustrative edit plan: Lucy Edit Restyle.
Preservation goals: retain face and motion.
Output constraints: 720p with the source aspect ratio.

best_practices: State preservation goals before one specific change, then inspect the result for identity and motion drift.
Check input duration, format, size, and orientation before submitting a model request.
Use authorized media and confirm remote processing is acceptable; keep authentication tokens out of prompts and shared logs.
anti_patterns: Combining several unrelated changes in one request or expecting multi-model blending.
Using Lucy for complete subject replacement, custom aspect ratios, or output above 720p.
Submitting private media without permission or including account tokens in editing prompts.

faq.question: Which model is selected by default?
faq.answer: Wan 2.7 Edit-Video is the default. Kling handles motion transfer, while Lucy handles localized outfit and style changes.

faq.question: What must be installed before use?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI and authenticate with an account. Provide a source video URL that meets the selected model's limits.

faq.question: Can the original audio be preserved?
faq.answer: Wan offers the origin audio setting. Kling offers keep_original_sound. This skill does not document an equivalent Lucy audio option.

faq.question: Does video processing happen locally?
faq.answer: No. The CLI submits requests to RunComfy, and model servers fetch input media. Generated outputs are downloaded to the selected directory.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee identity preservation?
faq.answer: No. It supplies preservation prompts and model selection guidance. Review generated videos for face, movement, framing, and lip synchronization changes.

faq.question: Can one request combine several model routes?
faq.answer: No. The skill selects one model per call. Each route retains its own duration, resolution, and input restrictions.
